parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const x=$input.first()?.json||{};const t=(v,n=0)=>{const s=String(v??'').normalize('NFKC').trim();return n?s.slice(0,n):s};const principalKey=t(x.principalKey,100);if(!/^tgactor_[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(principalKey))throw new Error('consent_invalid_principal');const telegramActorId=t(x.telegramActorId,32);if(telegramActorId&&!/^\d+$/.test(telegramActorId))throw new Error('consent_invalid_actor');const consentType=t(x.consentType);if(!['privacy_processing','memory_storage','proactive_messages','analytics','file_storage'].includes(consentType))throw new Error('consent_invalid_type');const action=t(x.action);if(!['grant','revoke'].includes(action))throw new Error('consent_invalid_action');const policyVersion=t(x.policyVersion,64);if(!/^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$/.test(policyVersion))throw new Error('consent_invalid_policy_version');const source=t(x.source||'telegram');if(!['telegram','web','admin','migration'].includes(source))throw new Error('consent_invalid_source');const metadata=x.metadata&&typeof x.metadata==='object'&&!Array.isArray(x.metadata)?x.metadata:{};return [{json:{principalKey,telegramActorId,consentType,action,policyVersion,source,metadata}}];
